You can make changes directly through conversation with our Design Agent—just ask for specific adjustments like \"make the date more prominent\" or \"add more space for sponsor logos.\" You can also download editable files to make final adjustments in your preferred design tools."}]}]
description: Power your event marketing with Lovart’s AI Event Poster Generator. Our AI Design Agent understands event types, audiences, and information hierarchy to automatically create high‑impact posters, matching social graphics, and promotional sets—all in just a few prompts.
